description: Access Roles' Import current setup on its dashboard page, while nobody is managed: the box for users who see every library is there and unticked, Preview the import (a dry run) shows 'No change for N of the N users' with the proposed roles and the every-library users left out, Apply is enabled only then, and after the confirmation (since 0.9.8 the kit's dialog) the import is saved and the section goes. accessroles-sync-hooks-probe.mjs runs it on its own synthetic layout; it changes Access Roles' store only (no user's policy).

steps.name: Import current setup is shown, Apply disabled
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide)'); return !!p && p.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesStatus table').length === 5 && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesImport').hidden === false && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesImportApply').disabled === true; })()

steps.name: the box for users who see every library is there, unticked (they stay unmanaged by default)
steps.assert: (() => { const box = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide) #AccessRolesImportEveryLibrary'); return !!box && box.checked === false && /^Also manage users who see every library/.test(box.closest('label').textContent.trim()); })()

steps.name: the proposal is shown, Apply enabled
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const first = p.querySelector('#AccessRolesImportResult p'); return !!first && /^No change for \d+ of the \d+ users/.test(first.textContent) && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesImportApply').disabled === false; })()

steps.name: what the preview shows
steps.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const box = p.querySelector('#AccessRolesImportResult'); const rows = Array.from(box.querySelectorAll('tr')).map(tr => [tr.querySelector('th').textContent, tr.querySelector('td').textContent]); return { summary: box.querySelector('p').textContent, headings: Array.from(box.querySelectorAll('h4')).map(h => h.textContent), rows, warnings: Array.from(box.querySelectorAll('li')).map(li => li.textContent) }; })()

steps.name: no change for every user it would assign, nobody's access written
steps.assert: (() => { const m = /^No change for (\d+) of the (\d+) users/.exec(__vars.preview.summary); return !!m && m[1] === m[2] && Number(m[2]) > 0 && __vars.preview.headings[0] === 'Proposed roles' && !__vars.preview.headings.includes('Users whose library access would be written') && __vars.preview.rows.length > 0; })()

steps.name: the users who see every library are left out, in one warning, and no role gives every library
every value is text (no element inside a value cell)
the page asks to confirm (the kit's dialog), the focus inside it
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfar-backdrop .jfar-panel'); return !!p && p.querySelector('h3').textContent === 'Import current setup' && !!p.querySelector('.jfar-button-primary') && p.contains(document.activeElement); })()

steps.name: imported
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const first = p && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesImportResult p'); return !!first && /^Imported: \d+ roles, \d+ users\./.test(first.textContent); })()

steps.name: the section goes once users are managed
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide)'); return !!p && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesImport').hidden === true && Array.from(p.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesStatus tr')).some(tr => tr.querySelector('th').textContent === 'Users with roles or overrides' && tr.querySelector('td').textContent !== '0'); })()

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
